name: @mithrilman/aind-drawn
description: Deterministic procedural drawing primitives and layered sprite rigs for browser experiments.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && vite build --config experiments/playground/vite.config.ts
scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && eslint . && vitest run && node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node scripts/verify-library.mjs && vite build --config experiments/playground/vite.config.ts
